from.place: 09NC proof: the tensor products of the chosen generating sections generate the tensor product module

title: Tensor products of finite generating families generate the tensor product module
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal F_1,\ldots,\mathcal F_n$ be $\mathcal O_X$-modules, and for each $i$ let $s_{i,0},\ldots,s_{i,m_i}$ be global sections generating $\mathcal F_i$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections]. Then the finitely many global sections $s_{1,j_1}\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\cdots\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}s_{n,j_n}$, with $0\le j_i\le m_i$, generate $\mathcal F_1\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\cdots\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal F_n$.
